<code><nowiki>{{QuestLink}}</nowiki></code> renders a quest page link. The ordinary positional page-title form is the supported first-class form:

<pre>{{QuestLink|A Magical Sword in Port Azure}}</pre>

The positional page title supplies the destination and the visible text. Use explicit presentation fields when the destination or displayed text differs:

<pre>{{QuestLink
 |A Magical Sword in Port Azure
 |link=A Magical Sword in Port Azure
 |text=Magical Sword quest
}}</pre>

The link picker may supply <code>stablekey</code>. This is the exact advanced quest identity selected by the picker. It distinguishes quest records independently of their display text. Editors normally do not need to memorize or type it. A stable-key-only form is intended for generated links:

<pre>{{QuestLink|stablekey=quest:a magical sword in port azure}}</pre>

QuestLink renders text only. It has no image or image-only mode.

== Parameters ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter
! Description
|-
| <code>1</code>
| Quest page and default display text. The first positional page-title parameter is the usual form.
|-
| <code>stablekey</code>
| Exact advanced quest identity selected automatically by the Erenshor link picker. Usually leave this to generated links.
|-
| <code>link</code> or <code>page</code>
| Explicit destination page.
|-
| <code>text</code>
| Visible link text.
|}
